title: Location and size of the County
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use a cut-out paper county split into sub-counties and wards like a puzzle. Real county names come only from the teacher; questions use imaginary counties.

skills.key_step: The child puts county, sub-county and ward in order of size and says which holds which.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the name of the place where they live.
floor.question: Name the village or estate where you live.

representations: a paper county cut into sub-county pieces, each cut into wards
nested boxes, the biggest for the county
steps: Say the order from biggest to smallest.
contexts: the ward where the MCA is elected
the sub-county office where birth certificates are collected
the county where the Governor serves

board.do: Draw a large box labelled county.
Split it into three parts labelled sub-county.

board.say: What smaller pieces can we cut this into?

board.do: Write county, sub-county, ward from big to small.

misconceptions.ask: Which is bigger, a county or a sub-county?
misconceptions.repair: Use boxes inside boxes: the county box holds several sub-county boxes, which hold wards.

misconceptions.ask: Which is the smallest unit: county, sub-county or ward?
misconceptions.repair: Draw the three nested boxes and label them from the outside in; then ask for smallest and largest.

listen_for: Yes, it is a sub-county of Kalia
misconceptions.ask: Kalia County has a neighbour called Mwangaza County. Is Mwangaza one of the sub-counties of Kalia?
misconceptions.repair: Draw two county boxes side by side and a boundary line between them; sub-counties are drawn inside one box only.

misconceptions.ask: Which is smaller: a ward or a county?
misconceptions.repair: Fit the puzzle: wards into a sub-county, sub-counties into the county, and count the pieces.

checks.question: Put in order from biggest: ward, county, sub-county.
A learner says the sub-county is bigger than the county. Is this right?
checks.answer: No: the county is made of sub-counties

skills.key_step: The child finds the counties that share a boundary with their county and names the direction of each.

floor.prerequisite: Gives the direction from one place to another on a described map.
floor.question: The shop is west of the school. Where is the school from the shop?

representations: a described map of imaginary counties
paper counties laid edge to edge
a table with the county in the middle
steps: Find your county on the map.
Run a finger along its boundary.
Every county touched is a neighbour.
Name the direction of each neighbour from your county.
contexts: a family travelling to a county next door for a wedding
cattle crossing a county boundary to find grass
a textbook map of imaginary counties

board.do: Draw a county with one county touching its east side and one further east that does not touch.
Wait for the child to check the boundary.
Show the gap: it does not touch, so it is not a neighbour.

misconceptions.ask: On a map, Kitale County lies north of Meru County. In which direction is Meru County from Kitale County?
misconceptions.repair: Mark two dots on paper and ask the direction from each dot to the other.

misconceptions.ask: Which county is a neighbour of Kalia County, with a shared boundary?
misconceptions.repair: Use a described map: trace the boundary of the county and name only the counties that touch it.

misconceptions.ask: Kibo Town is inside Mlima County. Is Kibo Town a neighbour county of Mlima?
misconceptions.repair: On the cut-out map, put a dot for the town inside the county and colour the counties that share the edge.

listen_for: One; only one county can be north
misconceptions.ask: Two counties both lie to the north of Mlima County and touch it. How many northern neighbours does Mlima have?
misconceptions.repair: Draw a county with two counties along its northern edge and count them.

checks.question: Mto County touches Mlima County on its south side. Where is Mlima from Mto?
Which counties are neighbours: those that share a boundary or those within the same region?

skills.key_step: The child compares county areas by the full number of square kilometres, not by how many people live there or how a picture looks.

floor.prerequisite: Can order whole numbers up to 10,000.
floor.question: Which is bigger, 3,000 or 800?

representations: squares on a grid standing for square kilometres
steps: Read each area with its unit.
Line up the numbers by place value.
contexts: comparing a large dry county with a small busy one
a textbook table of imaginary county areas
a farmer's small plot next to a big ranch

board.do: Write "Ziwa is bigger" and cross out the population column.

listen_for: County A, because it has more people
misconceptions.ask: County A has 3,000 square kilometres and 900,000 people. County B has 12,000 square kilometres and 400,000 people. Which county is larger in size?
misconceptions.repair: Compare a large empty field and a small crowded classroom: which has more space and which has more people?

misconceptions.ask: County A is 800 square kilometres and County B is 3,000 square kilometres. Which is larger?
misconceptions.repair: Write the two numbers in a place value table and compare the thousands first.

misconceptions.ask: Map A shows Ziwa County large on a full page. Map B shows Mlima County small in a corner. The table says Ziwa is 2,000 square kilometres and Mlima 6,000. Which is bigger?
misconceptions.repair: Draw the same classroom on a big sheet and on a small card: the room did not change size.

misconceptions.ask: Ziwa County is 3 thousand square kilometres. Mlima is 900 square kilometres. Which is bigger?
misconceptions.repair: Write both as full numbers, 3,000 and 900, and line up the digits by place value.

checks.question: Ziwa County is 1,200 square kilometres with 900,000 people. Mto County is 5,000 square kilometres with 300,000 people. Which county is bigger?
Which is larger: 4,050 or 950 square kilometres?
